applications.name: Galvanize

applications.name: Buff Synthesis - Fury/Precision
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker activates a Precision Buff while they have a Fury Buff active, both Buffs are consumed and the Attacker instead gains an indefinite Prowess Buff increasing Special Attack by 50%.

applications.name: Power Struggle

applications.name: Buff Synthesis - Fury/Precision
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker activates a Precision Buff while they have a Fury Buff active, both Buffs are consumed and the Attacker instead gains an indefinite Prowess Buff increasing Special Attack by 50%.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker activates a Precision Buff while they have a Fury Buff active, both Buffs are consumed and the Attacker instead gains an indefinite Prowess Buff increasing Special Attack by 50%.

applications.name: Power Struggle
applications.description: The Attacker cannot gain Power during the fight through normal means. Each time the Defender reaches a full Bar of Power, the Attacker is granted one as well and whenever the Defender launches a Special Attack, the Attacker loses an equal amount of Power.
applications.rawDescription: The Attacker cannot gain Power during the fight through normal means. Each time the Defender reaches a full Bar of Power, the Attacker is granted one as well and whenever the Defender launches a Special Attack, the Attacker loses an equal amount of Power.

applications.name: Subterfuge - Block
applications.description: Each time the Attacker performs a Well-Timed block they gain a Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by 5% for 10 seconds. This cannot be prevented by Ability Accuracy Modification.
applications.rawDescription: Each time the Attacker performs a Well-Timed block they gain a Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by {1}% for {2} seconds. This cannot be prevented by Ability Accuracy Modification.

applications.name: Combat Déjà vu (Unblockable)
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker lands the same type of [k=glossary/basic_attack]Basic Attack[/k] twice in a row, the Defender gains an [k=glossary/unblockable]Unblockable[/k] Buff for 6 seconds.

applications.name: Power Struggle
applications.description: The Attacker cannot gain Power during the fight through normal means. Each time the Defender reaches a full Bar of Power, the Attacker is granted one as well and whenever the Defender launches a Special Attack, the Attacker loses an equal amount of Power.
